connector.name: Redmine MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server that lets AI assistants manage Redmine issues, projects, wikis, and time tracking
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package redmine-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jztan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: REDMINE_URL
env.description: URL of your Redmine server (e.g., https://your-redmine-server.com)

env.name: REDMINE_USERNAME
env.description: Redmine username for authentication (alternative to API key)

env.name: REDMINE_PASSWORD
env.description: Redmine password for authentication (alternative to API key)

env.name: REDMINE_API_KEY
env.description: Redmine API key for authentication (alternative to username/password)

env.name: SERVER_HOST
env.description: Host address for the MCP server (default: 0.0.0.0)

env.name: PUBLIC_HOST
env.description: Public hostname for file download URLs (default: localhost)

env.name: PUBLIC_PORT
env.description: Public port for file download URLs (default: 8000)

env.name: AUTO_CLEANUP_ENABLED
env.description: Enable automatic cleanup of expired files (default: true)

env.name: CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MINUTES
env.description: Interval between cleanup runs in minutes (default: 10)

env.name: ATTACHMENT_EXPIRES_MINUTES
env.description: Default expiry time for attachments in minutes (default: 60)
